//: CI gate config for the ops dashboard. Checked as served, never as a saved copy.
//webServer: gates run starts this and stops it after, so CI needs no shell wrapper.

defaults.//gates: --wait-until load on every navigating gate: /api/live is an EventSource held open for the life of the page, so the default `networkidle` milestone never fires and every gate times out at 30s having reported nothing.
defaults.//rules: check.a11y.touch has no --exclude and no per-selector --allow, so a vendor subtree can only be handled by turning the single rule off page-wide. Recorded here so `gates suppressions` can audit and expire it.

check.a11y.touch/target-undersized.reason: The only undersized targets are the charting library's own 24x24 zoom/reset buttons (.vendorchart-ctrl), which we do not own and will not fork. Our own .btn controls are min-height 44px. Revisit when check a11y touch gains a subtree exclusion, or when the library ships larger controls.

suppressions.flag: --allow "button#acknowledge;Acknowledge is the deliberate primary action and carries the accent fill"
suppressions.reason: One deliberate variant in a 3-button role averages 1.5x reuse, which no --min-reuse threshold can express; named per instance instead. NOTE: allowing it drops the role to 2 instances, which is below the default --min-instances 3 and silently stops the role being judged at all — hence --min-instances 2 --min-reuse 2 on the gate, without which this gate reports COHERENT no matter what our own buttons do.
